headline: Variance application for a fence at 15 Windswept Road, within a wetland buffer and setback.
summary: Stephanie and Aaron Theriault will present a variance request to build a fence at 15 Windswept Road. The meeting also covers outreach, a proposed change to meeting dates, and other business.
items: Presentation by Stephanie and Aaron Theriault for 15 Windswept Road (Tax Map 822, Lot 2B) on variance application ZBA2026-070 to build a fence within the no disturbance buffer and structural setback from a wetland
Discussion on Conservation Commission outreach initiatives
Discussion on changing Conservation Commission meetings to the fourth Wednesday of each month
location: Walter Stiles Room, 2nd Floor, Manchester City Hall, One City Hall Plaza

MANCHESTER CONSERVATION COMMISSION

MEETING AGENDA  
of the   
MANCHESTER CONSERVATION COMMISSION 
           
July 23, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
Walter Stiles Room 
2nd Floor 
Manchester City Hall 
One City Hall Plaza 
 
I. Call to order. 
II. Roll. 
III. Presentation by Stephanie and Aaron Theriault for property located at 15 Windswept Road 
(Tax Map 822, Lot 2B ), regarding a variance  application (ZBA2026-070) in front of the 
Manchester Zoning Board of Adjustment to construct a fence within  the required no 
disturbance buffer and structural setback from a wetland. 
IV. Discussion on Conservation Commission outreach initiatives. 
V. Discussion on changing Conservation Commission meetings  to the fourth Wednesday of 
each month. 
VI. Review of prior meeting minutes. 
VII. Staff update. 
VIII. Other business. 
IX. Adjournment.
